meta.prompt: Build a small checkout in three steps. Step 1, my cart: Espresso beans $24 x1, Ceramic mug $12 x2, Canvas tote $18 x1, with quantities I can change and the subtotal. Step 2, shipping: name, address, city, postcode and email, all required, with a message under a field that is empty or an email without an @. Step 3, payment summary: a choice of Standard delivery ($4, 3 to 5 working days) or Express ($12, next working day) that changes the total, subtotal plus delivery. Then a confirmation with an order number, my name, my email and the total I paid. I can go back a step without losing what I typed.
meta.text:
state step=1
state items=[{"id":1,"name":"Espresso beans","price":24,"qty":1,"kind":"box","tone":"sand"},{"id":2,"name":"Ceramic mug","price":12,"qty":2,"kind":"mug","tone":"rose"},{"id":3,"name":"Canvas tote","price":18,"qty":1,"kind":"tote","tone":"mint"}]
state name=""
state address=""
state city=""
state postcode=""
state email=""
state delivery="standard"
state orderNo="ORD-48213"
let subtotal = sum(items, i => i.qty * i.price)
let shipCost = delivery == "express" ? 12 : 4
let total = subtotal + shipCost
let nameErr = name == "" ? "Name is required" : ""
let addressErr = address == "" ? "Address is required" : ""
let cityErr = city == "" ? "City is required" : ""
let postcodeErr = postcode == "" ? "Postcode is required" : ""
let emailErr = email == "" ? "Email is required" : (contains(email, "@") ? "" : "Enter a valid email")
let shipValid = nameErr == "" and addressErr == "" and cityErr == "" and postcodeErr == "" and emailErr == ""
ChatCard "Checkout" "Step {step} of 3" icon:"shopping_bag" status:"{step==1 ? "Cart" : (step==2 ? "Shipping" : (step==3 ? "Payment" : "Done"))}"
  if step == 1
    SectionLabel "Your cart" "{length(items)} items"
    each item in items
      CartLine "{item.name}" "" price:{item.price} qty:{item.qty} kind:{item.kind} tone:{item.tone} -> items=updateWhere(items, x => x.id == item.id, x => with(x, "qty", result))
    Details rows:=[["Subtotal", money(subtotal,"$",2)]]
    TotalBar "Subtotal" "Before delivery" amount:{money(subtotal,"$",2)} cta:"Next" enabled:{length(items) > 0} -> step=2
  if step == 2
    SectionLabel "Shipping address" "All fields required"
    InputField "Full name" "Jane Smith" =name error:{nameErr}
    InputField "Address" "12 High Street" =address error:{addressErr}
    InputField "City" "London" =city error:{cityErr}
    InputField "Postcode" "SW1A 1AA" =postcode error:{postcodeErr}
    InputField "Email" "you@example.com" =email error:{emailErr}
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Back" quiet -> step=1
      ActionButton "Continue" primary enabled:{shipValid} -> step=3
  if step == 3
    SectionLabel "Delivery" "Choose one"
    OptionList "Delivery method" =delivery options:["standard","express"] details:["$4, 3 to 5 working days","$12, next working day"] -> delivery=result
    Details rows:=[["Subtotal", money(subtotal,"$",2)],["Delivery", money(shipCost,"$",2)]]
    TotalBar "Total" "Subtotal plus delivery" amount:{money(total,"$",2)} cta:"Pay" -> orderNo=orderNo; step=4
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Back" quiet -> step=2
  if step == 4
    Receipt "Order confirmed" "Thanks {name}, a receipt is on its way to {email}." code:{orderNo} codeLabel:"Order number" tone:good icon:"check"
    Details rows:=[["Name", name],["Email", email],["Total paid", money(total,"$",2)]]

delta: t is on its way to {email
